verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents clients for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and Web, and is distributed through F-Droid and Flathub. Hands-on reports confirm cross-OS sessions: Windows controlling a Mac Mini, Ubuntu-to-Mac, and daily Linux-to-Windows use across many machines. Rough edges include alt-tab and file copy-paste failing Linux→Windows, an Android-tablet-to-PC hard reboot, an install failure on an older macOS, and Wayland unattended access only in a preview build. missing for 10: a documented supported-OS-version matrix, reliable cross-OS parity (clipboard/keyboard Linux→Windows, Android-to-PC stability), and full Wayland support outside the preview build.
